necessity_paragraph: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness in the setting of known paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0) and atherosclerotic heart disease (I25.10). Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) is ordered to correlate these symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias and to assess the efficacy of current rate control management. This service is medically necessary to address the specific clinical need defined by diagnosis codes I48.0, I25.10, and I48.91.
